summary: Ibis implementation of the expression system. IbisExpressionSystem is composed from the same Substrait and Mountainash-extension protocol mixins as the Polars backend and compiles the unified AST into deferred ibis.expr.types expressions, which makes it the route to SQL engines (DuckDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and others). It is imported only when the ibis package is installed. IbisBaseExpressionSystem resolves operand metadata from table schemas without executing the table.
key_classes: IbisExpressionSystem — composed concrete backend registered for CONST_BACKEND.IBIS
SubstraitIb*/MountainAshIb* mixins — per-family implementations under substrait/ and extensions_mountainash/
key_functions: IbisBaseExpressionSystem.field_operand_type(input_data, field) — operand metadata from Ibis schema
IbisBaseExpressionSystem.fixed_result_type(...) — declared fixed result mapped to dt.boolean/dt.string
extension_points: @register_expression_system(CONST_BACKEND.IBIS) registers the composed class with the visitor factory
declare_builtin_expression_system(<cls>, 'ibis') declares the system for function-mapping lowering

Add an operation by implementing the protocol method in the matching substrait/ or extensions_mountainash/ expsys_*_<family> mixin, which is composed by multiple inheritance (backend-composition principle)
